text: Discipline Positioning:Mathematics is a fundamental discipline that studies quantity, structure, change and spatial forms. It belongs to the category of science and usually lasts for four years, conferring a Bachelor of Science degree. This major is based on theoretical research and has extremely strong application value. It is an important tool in fields such as natural science, engineering technology, social science and information technology.Core features:Emphasizing the cultivation of logical reasoning, abstract thinking and mathematical modeling abilities, it is divided into directions such as basic mathematics (theoretical research), applied mathematics (practical problem solving), computational mathematics (numerical computation), probability theory and mathematical statistics (data analysis), etc.It highly intersects with disciplines such as physics, computer science, and economics, forming cross-disciplinary research (such as financial mathematics and biomatrics).
